t: Unified by Æthelstan in 927, England became one of the most centralised kingdoms of medieval Europe.
It developed the common law, Magna Carta and Parliament, institutions later carried across the world.
Joined with Scotland under one crown in 1603, it merged into the Kingdom of Great Britain in 1707.
dyk: Domesday Book, compiled in 1086 for William the Conqueror, surveyed more than 13,000 places in England and is one of the most complete records of any medieval kingdom.
ev: Æthelstan takes York and receives the submission of the northern rulers
William of Normandy defeats Harold Godwinson at the Battle of Hastings
King John accepts Magna Carta at Runnymede
Henry V defeats the French at the Battle of Agincourt
The Act of Supremacy makes Henry VIII head of the Church of England
English ships help defeat the Spanish Armada
Charles I is executed and the Commonwealth of England proclaimed
The Acts of Union create the Kingdom of Great Britain
